name: about-us-network-monitor
description: Live network monitor for the ABOUTUS event network, hosted on the Raspberry Pi (aboutus-net).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:demo -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
